name: session-band
description: A band above the prompt naming the computer, workspace and project a Claude Code session runs in, with a row of session stats.

style.title: Band style
style.description: tree: colored icons, with herdr on a second row. bookends: powerline segments, with herdr pinned to the right edge.

icons.title: Band icons
icons.description: auto: plain Unicode symbols inside herdr (which draws Nerd Font icons as boxes), Nerd Font icons elsewhere. nerd and unicode force one set.

stats.title: Band stats
stats.description: on: a row with the context gauge, rate limits, cost, session age and compaction count. off: no stats row.
